## Description {#details}

The <code><Link to="/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/throws-">throws&#95;</Link></code> struct template provides a type-safe mechanism for verifying whether a callable expression throws a specified exception type during its execution within the framework.

This comparator is designed to support both custom and standard callable types. The result of the exception check is stored in the <code>value&#95;</code> member for efficient access.

The implementation is optimised for use in embedded environments and supports both compile-time and run-time evaluation.

All definitions are intended for internal use within the framework and are implemented in the <code>include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus</code> folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.


<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="Callable&#95;T">The type of the callable object to be invoked.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="Exception&#95;T">The type of the exception to check for (defaults to <code>void</code> for any exception).</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>
